summary: Module-level STORAGE_REGISTRY: a mountainash_settings.profiles.Registry named 'storage', constrained to StorageProfileSpec specs and StorageProfileProtocol profile classes. It exposes the register decorator used by every provider profile and lookup helpers get_spec(name) and get_settings_class(name); get_descriptor is a deprecated alias of get_spec. The module imports the profiles package at the bottom so the registry is populated on import.
key_classes: STORAGE_REGISTRY (mountainash_settings Registry instance) — maps provider keys ('s3','local','sftp','http','gcs','azure_storage','ftp','smb','github_repo') to StorageProfileSpec and profile class
key_functions: register — STORAGE_REGISTRY.decorator(); reads cls.__spec__ and registers the class
get_spec(name) -> StorageProfileSpec — spec lookup by provider key (KeyError if unknown)
extension_points: Decorate a Profile subclass carrying a StorageProfileSpec __spec__ with @register to make it discoverable by resolve_storage and registry lookups
lifecycle_notes: Populated on import via a bottom-of-module 'from . import profiles'; that import must stay last because profile modules import register from here
Requires [http] (mountainash_settings); the registry is distinct from storage.registry, which maps provider types to backend classes
documentation_hooks: Discovering providers: list STORAGE_REGISTRY.specs and inspect spec.parameters / supported_auth
Two registries explained: profile registry (settings.storage.registry) vs backend registry (storage.registry)
risks: get_descriptor's DeprecationWarning promises removal 'before mountainash-transport 26.6.0' but the package version is 0.1.0 and the date in the message has passed, so the removal deadline is not meaningful
Module docstring sits after the imports and is not the module __doc__
Import cycle with profiles/ is load-order sensitive (documented by a comment)
open_questions: Is this module part of the documented public surface? It is not exported from the package root, but the user-facing storage_profiles example imports get_spec/get_settings_class from it directly.

evidence.detail: Not re-exported from root __all__ (basis for semi-public)
Recent change be3e7b4 only moved population-on-import; API otherwise steady
